run_shutdown_servers: run the shutdown_servers function to stop prometheus and grafana metrics servers using stored PIDs
run_shutdown_prometheus: run the shutdown_prometheus_server function to stop the prometheus metrics server using stored PIDs
run_shutdown_grafana: run the shutdown_grafana_server function to stop the grafana metrics server using stored PIDs
run_set_log_level: run set_mephisto_log_level to configure the mephisto logger to info level before shutting down servers
run_script_cli: run the shutdown_metrics script directly via CLI to shutdown all metrics servers using stored PIDs
